annotations.title: TikTok negative keywords (ad account, campaign or ad group)

description: Search terms a TikTok ad must NOT show for. level "advertiser" (default) is the whole ad account, or "campaign" / "adgroup" with objectId. action "list" reads them; "add" takes keywords (words, or {text, match} with match exact, phrase or broad; broad by default; up to 1,000, 80 characters each); "update" changes one (keywordId + keyword, fromMatch when the word has several match types); "remove" deletes keywordIds (match narrows it to one match type). A negative is a word plus a match type, and the keyword id names the word, so one id can carry several match types. Adding only narrows who sees the ads and runs on the ask; update, remove and add with replace:true let ads show on searches they were kept off, so they need confirm:true after the user agrees. Every change is read back from TikTok. Free.

advertiserId.description: TikTok ad account id from list_tiktok_ads_accounts; omit when only one account is shared with this profile

confirm.description: true after the user agreed to an update, remove or replace

fromMatch.description: update: which match type of keywordId to change, when the word has several

keyword.description: update: the new text and match type

keywordId.description: update: the keyword id from action list

keywordIds.description: remove: keyword ids from action list

level.description: advertiser (the whole ad account, default), campaign or adgroup

match.description: remove: only this match type of those words

objectId.description: campaign or ad group id; omit at advertiser level

objectIds.description: add only: several campaigns or ad groups at once, up to 50

replace.description: add: true REPLACES every existing negative on the object with these (needs confirm:true)

name: manage_tiktok_ads_negative_keywords
